test_title: PYST 08: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Awareness (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following pairs is incorrectly matched?

options.text: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao - Ministry of Women & Child Dev.
PM JANMAN - Ministry of Tribal Affairs

solution:
The correct answer is __**Swadesh Darshan - Ministry of Culture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Swadesh Darshan** is not implemented by the Ministry of Culture; it is a flagship scheme of the **Ministry of Tourism**.
 
• The scheme was launched in **2014-15** to promote, develop, and harness the potential of tourism in India.
 
• It focuses on the development of thematic tourist circuits across India, including **Buddhist Circuit, Himalayan Circuit, Coastal Circuit, etc.**
 
• The objective of the scheme is to **integrate the development of theme-based circuits** while ensuring sustainable and inclusive growth.
 
• The Ministry of Culture primarily focuses on the promotion of **art, heritage, and culture-related initiatives**, not tourism infrastructure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__**

 
• **PM MITRA - Ministry of Textiles**

 
 
• The **PM Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel (PM MITRA)** scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Textiles.
 
• It aims to create world-class infrastructure for the entire textile value chain, from spinning to garment manufacturing.
 
• Under this scheme, **seven PM MITRA parks** will be established across India.
 
 
 
• **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao - Ministry of Women & Child Development**
 
 
• The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Women & Child Development in collaboration with the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and the Ministry of Education.
 
• It aims to address the declining child sex ratio and promote the education of girls.
 
• It was launched in **2015** in Haryana.
 
 
 
• **PM JANMAN - Ministry of Tribal Affairs**
 
 
• The **PM Janjatiya Gaurav Yojana** falls under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs.
 
• It aims to preserve and promote the rich cultural heritage of tribal communities.
 
• It also includes initiatives for the socio-economic development of tribal populations.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Culture**
 
 
• The Ministry of Culture is responsible for promoting and preserving the art, culture, and heritage of India.
 
• It implements schemes such as the **National Mission on Cultural Mapping** and the **Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat initiative**.
